defects.problem: Share-dialog crop is cut at the top edge: 'I checked this picture' is sliced through mid-line. After the link appears, the 'Copy link / Delete now' buttons are sliced at the bottom of the panel. The white card has a large empty lower half, and the panel is pinned left with a wide empty right side holding only the floating caption.
defects.fix: Re-frame the same recording crop so the whole checkbox row and the whole button row sit inside the panel with even margins. Or hold on frames where they already do. No zoom needed.

defects.problem: The phone clip is clipped by its own bezel. The top is cut mid-line, with status bar and dynamic island over text ('Shared guid... Monday 9' collides with the clock, and 'subscription' is half visible). The bottom is cut mid-sentence ('person who shared this' sliced, 'Your path, 1 step' cut). The Safari URL pill ('showme-web-delta.vercel.app') sits on top of body text ('Stuck on the next screen? Take a new sc...').
defects.fix: Choose phone-recording frames where the content does not run under the island or the URL pill. Or mask the clip with a safe-area inset so text is never half-cut.

defects.problem: The phone panel enlarges to a pinch-zoomed excerpt (text 'ap the Cancel subsc / utton at the bottom' cut off at both sides, 'Previous step' and 'Next step' buttons cropped). Then it fades out mid-dissolve to a nearly empty panel. This is the exact unneeded zoom the founder complained about. The excerpt is cropped and the dissolve leaves a ghosted half-state.
defects.fix: Drop the zoomed excerpt. Hold the unzoomed phone frame and cut straight to the Photos frame.

defects.problem: The 'original in Photos' phone frame is mostly black bars. The screenshot content is tiny and unreadable beside a large synthetic page. It reads as a dead panel.
defects.fix: Hold this frame shorter, or place it in a tighter slot sized to the screenshot so there is no black void.

defects.problem: Layout jumps at the section break. The first half is a left panel with a right-aligned two-line headline. The second half is a left synthetic page plus a phone with a different caption position. Phone content shifts between frames (different scroll offset and battery 41 to 42 between middle and end), so the same screen appears at different heights.
defects.fix: Lock one phone scroll position across the section, using frames from a single take.

defects.problem: The highlighted control in the phone thumbnail ('Cancel subscription' outline and the '1' badge) is only about 70px wide and its label is unreadable. The left synthetic page text is also tiny. Captions at the bottom are large and clear.
defects.fix: Give the phone panel more height inside the existing layout, with no zoom, so the outlined control reads larger.

defects.problem: First frame is a dissolve overlay with the previous section's 'click point never moves' content showing through. It reads as a muddy double exposure.
defects.fix: Shorten the dissolve, or cut cleanly on the section boundary.

phone panel scroll motion inside the clip
feed-size legibility (no feed-size image given for this section)
oneLineVerdict: Honest and well-captioned, but clipped crops on the share dialog and phone, text under the island and URL pill, and a pinch-zoom excerpt keep it near the rejected cut.
